entries.note: The shipment status in the example reply of Averitt's PRO Tracking API: collected from the shipper.
The status over the tracking page once the freight is delivered.
A progression row: the freight was collected from the shipper.
A progression row: the freight left the origin service center.
A progression row of an archived tracking page: the freight reached a relay terminal.
A progression row of an archived tracking page: the freight left a relay terminal.
A progression row: the freight reached the delivering service center.
A progression row of an archived tracking page: the freight left on a delivery run.
A progression row of an archived tracking page, after a delivery run that did not deliver: it says where the freight is, not that a delivery failed.
A progression row: the freight was delivered.
